camel_example: aliyun mns-open SetTopicAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --TopicName test --version 2022-01-19 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the attributes of a topic
description_zh: 调用SetTopicAttributes接口来修改主题的属性
name: SetTopicAttributes

parameters.help_en: The name of the topic. The name can be up to 120 characters in length. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens
parameters.help_zh: 主题名称。最长 120 个字符，须以英文字母开头，后续可使用英文字母、数字和短划线
parameters.name: topic_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the log management feature. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志管理功能。取值说明如下：

true：启用。

false：停用。
默认值：false
parameters.name: enable_logging

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of a message body sent to the topic. Valid values: 1024 to 65536. Unit: bytes. Default value: 65536
parameters.help_zh:
发送到该主题的消息体最大长度。
取值范围：1024~ 65536，单位为Byte。
默认值：65536
parameters.name: max_message_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable server-side encryption for message bodies. Valid values: true or false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启消息体的服务端存储加密。取值：true 或 false
parameters.name: enable_sse

parameters.help_en: The server-side encryption method. Valid values: SMQ (service-managed key) or KMS (customer-managed KMS key)
parameters.help_zh: 服务端存储加密方式。取值：SMQ（服务托管密钥）或 KMS（用户管理的 KMS 密钥）
parameters.name: sse_type

parameters.help_en: The server-side encryption algorithm. Currently, only AES-256-GCM is supported. If you do not specify this parameter, the default algorithm is used
parameters.help_zh: 服务端存储加密算法。当前支持 AES-256-GCM；不填写时使用默认算法
parameters.name: sse_algorithm

parameters.help_en: The KMS key ID. This parameter is required when you use KMS for encryption. The key must belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account and region as the topic
parameters.help_zh: 使用 KMS 加密时填写 KMS 密钥 ID；密钥需与主题属于同一账号、同一地域
parameters.name: kms_key_id

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
Indicates whether the request is successful
